title: Dobsonville, Soweto (map point estimated): girl, 11, swept away by flash floodwater after school transport drop-off, 17 Nov; body recovered 20 Nov
summary: An 11-year-old girl was swept away by fast-flowing floodwater on the afternoon of Tuesday 17 November in Dobsonville, Soweto, during heavy rain and thunderstorms, shortly after her school transport dropped her off, the M...
story: An 11-year-old girl was swept away by fast-flowing floodwater on the afternoon of Tuesday 17 November in Dobsonville, Soweto, during heavy rain and thunderstorms, shortly after her school transport dropped her off, the Mail & Guardian and IOL report. IOL places the drop-off in Snake Park, near Dobsonville Extension 3. Joburg EMS, the SAPS Water Wing and K9 Unit, police divers, private security, City Parks workers and residents searched the stream; her body was recovered on Friday 20 November not far from where she was last seen, the Mail & Guardian reports, and her family identified her. Gauteng CoGTA MEC Jacob Mamabolo was at the scene. The child is not named here. The map point is estimated: the Dobsonville suburb point, not the stream.
incident: Tue 17 Nov 2026, afternoon (Mail & Guardian; IOL). Body recovered Fri 20 Nov.
reported: 20 Nov 2026 (Mail & Guardian; IOL), both on the recovery; earlier search reports exist
location_note: ESTIMATED MAP POINT. Dobsonville, Soweto; drop-off in Snake Park near Dobsonville Extension 3 (IOL). Snake Park and Extension 3 are not found in Nominatim, so the pin is the Dobsonville suburb point (-26.2239, 27.8667), not the stream. Suburb level, about 2 km.
